title: It's Great to Be a Cow in World of Warcraft: Forever
summary:
Mulgore is home to the tauren, cow-like people in World of Warcraft. Right now, it is great to be a tauren.

Long ago, tauren learned a skill called Plainsrunning. In the first test version, tauren did not get horses at level 40, likely because they were too big. Instead, they could run as fast as a horse.

That idea did not last. Tauren were given kodos to ride instead, and Plainsrunning was forgotten for years.

Then it came back in WoW: Forever. This time, tauren got faster the longer they ran, as long as they did not stop or fight.

After the test ended, Blizzard made it better. Now tauren can run 60 percent faster. That is as fast as a first mount, which players do not get until level 40. But tauren can use it at level 1.

It takes time to reach top speed. Tauren get one stack every few seconds, and each stack adds 2 percent, up to 30 stacks. Still, tauren are now zooming across Mulgore. You will need a horse to catch this cow!
why_it_matters: If you play a game, it shows how one small change can make starting out feel faster and more fun right from level 1.

background_read: Plainsrunning is a special skill that lets tauren, the cow-like people of World of Warcraft, run as fast as a horse without riding one.
Long ago, tauren did not get horses because they were too big, so they learned to run fast on their own instead.
The skill was forgotten for years, but it came back in WoW: Forever, and now tauren get faster the longer they keep running.
Article_Structure: WHO: The tauren, cow-like people in World of Warcraft, and Blizzard, which brought back their running skill.
WHAT: Plainsrunning returned in WoW: Forever and was improved so tauren can run 60 percent faster, as fast as a first mount.
WHERE: Mulgore, the tauren homeland, where tauren are now zooming across the land.
WHY: Tauren were too big for horses at level 40 in the first test version, so they were given a running skill instead, and now it lets them travel fast from level 1.
